activityType.description: Activity type. Example: "GENERAL_ACTIVITY". Enum: GENERAL_ACTIVITY, PROJECT_GENERAL_ACTIVITY, PROJECT_SPECIFIC_ACTIVITY, TASK

actions.description: Create a contact, typically linked to a customer.
actions.name: create-contact

customerId.description: Customer ID to link the contact to. Example: 93640703

departmentId.description: Department ID to assign the contact to. Example: 553503

displayName.description: Display name for the contact. Example: "John Doe"

isPrivateIndividual.description: Whether the customer is a private individual.

actions.description: Create (finalize) an invoice from one or more existing orders.
actions.name: create-invoice

orders.description: Exactly one existing order reference. Tripletex only supports a single order per invoice.

comment.description: Comment text for the specific invoice.

sendToCustomer.description: Whether to send the invoice to the customer. Defaults to true.

paymentTypeId.description: Payment type ID for prepayment. Must be supplied together with paidAmount.

paidAmount.description: Paid amount for prepayment, in invoice currency. Must be supplied together with paymentTypeId.

amountExcludingVatCurrency.description: Amount excluding VAT in invoice currency

isCreditNote.description: Whether this is a credit note

isCredited.description: Whether this invoice has been credited

creditedInvoiceId.description: Original invoice ID if this is a credit note

actions.description: Create a manual general ledger voucher (balanced double-entry posting).
actions.name: create-ledger-voucher

amount.description: Posting amount in company currency. Use positive for debit, negative for credit (or vice versa to balance).

row.description: Row index for the posting. Auto-assigned starting at 1 if omitted.

postings.description: Balanced double-entry postings. At least two lines required.

actions.description: Add a line item to an existing order.
actions.name: create-order-line

unitPriceExcludingVatCurrency.description: Unit price excluding VAT in the order currency

actions.description: Create an order for a customer.

isStockItem.description: Whether the product is a stock item.

costExcludingVatCurrency.description: Purchase cost excluding VAT in the product currency.

priceIncludingVatCurrency.description: Sales price including VAT in the product currency.

isCustomer.description: Whether the supplier is also a customer.
